/** Kept: documents the interface. */
export interface Shape {
  /** Kept: documents a member. */
  readonly name: string
  // deleted: a line comment
  readonly size: number
}

/** Kept: documents the function. */
export function area(shape: Shape): number {
  /** Deleted: floats inside a function body. */
  const doubled = shape.size * 2
  /* deleted: a plain block comment */
  return doubled
}
